run_curve25519_table_gen: run the script to generate Curve25519 precomputation tables as a C header file
create_point_addition: create a function that adds two elliptic curve points on Curve25519 using twisted Edwards formulas
create_scalar_multiplication: create a function that computes scalar multiplication of a Curve25519 base point using double-and-add
create_x_recovery: create a function that recovers the x-coordinate from a y-coordinate on Curve25519
create_c_literal_gen: create a function that generates C preprocessor literals for 255-bit field elements in base 51 or base 25-5
